ui.workspace.title: Workspaces
ui.workspace.intro: Choose a local folder for new sessions. Existing sessions keep their own working directory.
ui.workspace.default.detail: Determined by the Hermes runtime configuration
ui.workspace.scope.note: Removing a shortcut does not delete the folder or existing sessions. The directory is checked when a session is created; choose it again if it has moved or been deleted.
ui.usage.title: Usage statistics
ui.usage.intro: Usage recorded by the Hermes instance managed by this app.
ui.usage.start: Start the runtime to view usage statistics.
ui.usage.failed: Could not load usage statistics. Try again.
ui.usage.empty: No sessions were recorded in this period.
ui.usage.cost.note: Costs use estimates recorded by Hermes at the time, not provider invoices. — means no reliable nonzero estimate; pricing may be unavailable, free, or included with a subscription. Local estimates do not multiply reasoning tokens by an additional rate.
ui.usage.reasoning.note: Reasoning tokens are shown separately and are not added to input or output tokens.
ui.usage.chart.label: Input, output and reasoning token trends; exact values are in the daily table below
ui.usage.method: Each session's cumulative usage is grouped by its start date, so long-running sessions do not show exact daily consumption. Model details can include auxiliary tasks and may not reconcile with the overview. Local records are not provider billing data.

ui.about.intro: View product versions, licenses, tool origins, feedback and software updates.
ui.about.license.summary: Original product code copyrighted by Firewine uses PolyForm Strict 1.0.0: noncommercial use is allowed; modification, derivative works, distribution, and commercial use require Firewine's prior written permission.
ui.about.hermes.license: Hermes Agent retains its own MIT license. The product license does not change the upstream license.
ui.about.third.party.pending: An itemized third-party license inventory is not yet bundled. This page is not a complete third-party notice.
ui.about.tools.explain: This page distinguishes product-provided tool code from programs already installed on your computer. Detection does not imply distribution or licensing by this product.
ui.about.tools.powershell: The Windows desktop build includes the product's PowerShell Tool code. It uses PowerShell installed on your computer; no PowerShell interpreter is bundled.
ui.about.tools.system: See Tools and capabilities for local Python, Node, Git and other detections. Their providers determine their licenses and usage rights.
ui.about.feedback.pending: The public contact and feedback channels have not been confirmed. No public email or Issue destination is available yet.
ui.about.copy.scope: Only version, upstream commit, update channel and platform are copied; logs, secrets and conversations are excluded.
ui.about.update.unavailable: GitHub Releases are inaccessible. While the repository is private, the client cannot check or download anonymously; retry after it becomes public.
ui.about.update.none: Checked public Releases; no newer release is available for this channel and platform.
ui.about.update.rule: Stable receives only newer stable releases. RC receives newer RC and stable releases. Switching channels never downgrades automatically.
ui.about.update.manual: Checks and downloads Windows and macOS installers with SHA-256 verification. Installation and recovery are not yet available.
